about: 7.0.1 citation integrity: shared cases for backend/citations.py and Android intel/Realtime.kt (Citations). Each case: sources (the registry), the model's answer, and what the checked answer must / must not contain plus the report counts.

ai.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 with faster reasoning
ai.snippet: OpenAI on Monday released GPT-5.5, saying it answers 40% faster than its predecessor.

ai.title: Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 4 with a 2 million token context window
ai.snippet: Gemini 4 can read 2 million tokens at once and is available to developers from today.

weather.title: Weather in Pune, Maharashtra, India
weather.snippet: 22.7°C; feels like 22.1°C; clear sky; humidity 50%; today: 18.6–30.2°C, chance of rain 0%

weather.title: USD → INR reference rate for 2026-11-17
weather.snippet: 1 USD = 93.4800 INR (daily reference rate published for 2026-11-17, not a live market price)

cases.name: correct citation is kept
cases.answer: Right now Pune is 22.7°C with clear skies [W1].

cases.name: small model puts a fact under the wrong number: corrected
cases.answer: Google DeepMind unveiled Gemini 4 with a 2 million token context window [W1].

cases.name: wrong number on a figure: corrected by the number
cases.answer: GPT-5.5 answers 40% faster than before [W2].

cases.name: citation to a source that doesn't exist is removed
cases.answer: OpenAI released GPT-5.5 [W7].

cases.name: claim no source supports is marked unsupported
cases.answer: Apple bought Anthropic for 90 billion dollars [W1].

cases.name: a number the source doesn't contain is unsupported
cases.answer: One US dollar is 95.10 rupees today [W2].

cases.name: grouped markers are split and each checked
cases.answer: OpenAI released GPT-5.5 and Google unveiled Gemini 4 [W1, W2].

cases.name: a model's [W2](#) link wrapper becomes the plain marker
cases.answer: Gemini 4 reads 2 million tokens at once [W2](#).

cases.name: an invented URL is removed, a retrieved one kept
cases.answer: GPT-5.5 is out [W1]. Details: https://openai-news.example.com/gpt55 and https://www.theverge.com/ai/gpt-5-5

cases.name: markers with no sources at all are removed
cases.answer: Python 3.14 is the latest release [W1].

cases.name: uncited sentences are left alone
cases.answer: Here is a summary. Gemini 4 can read 2 million tokens [W2].

cases.name: a marker after the full stop refers to the sentence before it
cases.answer: OpenAI released GPT-5.5, which answers 40% faster. [W1]

cases.name: a lone marker at the end of a paragraph checks that paragraph
cases.answer:
**Gemini 4 arrives**
Google DeepMind's new model can read 2 million tokens. It is available to developers.
[W1]

Next topic.

cases.name: a sentence with its own words is judged alone, not rescued by the paragraph
cases.answer: Gemini 4 reads 2 million tokens [W2]. Apple bought Anthropic for 90 billion dollars [W2].

cases.name: a remark naming a source is kept as a reference, not marked unsupported
cases.answer: Please note that the information on [W1] is from an article published on Monday.

cases.name: 'In [W1], …' is a claim and is still checked
cases.answer: In [W1], Apple bought Anthropic for 90 billion dollars.

cases.name: a reference remark with a number the source lacks is still unsupported
cases.answer: The details in [W2] say it costs 99 dollars.

cases.name: 'According to [W2], …' is still checked (and corrected when wrong)
cases.answer: According to [W2], OpenAI released GPT-5.5, which answers 40% faster.

cases.name: a remark about source ages is checked against the real publication times (correct)
cases.answer: Note that the information on [W1] is from 5 hours ago, and the details in [W2] are from 4 hours ago.

cases.name: chained references with ages ('on [W1] and [W2] … 5 and 4 hours ago')
cases.answer: The information on [W1] and [W2] is from 5 and 4 hours ago.

cases.name: a wrong age in a remark about a source is unsupported
cases.answer: Please note that the information on [W1] is from 3 days ago.

cases.name: a marker followed by the source's own publisher and date is an attribution, not a claim
cases.answer: OpenAI released GPT-5.5, which answers 40% faster. [W1] The Verge, published 2026-11-18 11:06 (5 h ago)

cases.name: an attribution with a wrong publication date is still checked (unsupported)
cases.answer: OpenAI released GPT-5.5, which answers 40% faster. [W1] The Verge, published 2025-01-03 10:00

unverified_cases.name: a link given as a source without retrieval is labelled
contains: (unverified: from the model's memory, not retrieved)

unverified_cases.name: a markdown source link keeps its text, loses the link
an ordinary link that isn't a citation is left alone
